scored.answer: The forklift with a brown cardboard box enters from the right at about 3:10 and drives left across the aisle floor, stopping in front of the Aisle 2 and Aisle 3 racks around 3:17 to 3:27.
A white box truck backs toward Dock 1 starting around 9:52, getting closer by 9:57 (in the 9:30–10:00 span), and it backs into Dock 1 by about 10:00, with its rear trailer doors open.

Between about 15:22.5 and 15:27.5 (in the 15:00–15:30 segment), several cardboard boxes on the upper and middle shelves at the right end of Aisle 3 are knocked out of line and tilted toward the EXIT side. The captions describe them as knocked out of line rather than clearly falling off.
The worker in the yellow hi-vis vest walks across the floor from about 21:10 to 21:27, moving from left-center toward the right near the EXIT door by 21:22, before leaving view at about 21:27.5.

No spill is shown in any caption; the captions describe a forklift with a cardboard box, a worker pushing a grey cart, boxes knocked off shelves, a box appearing on a top shelf, and a blue vehicle, but none mention a spill on the floor.
The fire exit is blocked from about 32:17.5–32:22.5, when a stack of red boxes on a pallet appears in front of the EXIT door, until about 32:40–32:47.5, when they disappear.
At about 38:35, a worker in an orange vest and white hard hat climbs a metal ladder in front of the Aisle 1 racking, reaching the top of the rack by 38:47.5.

The captions do not show two forklifts nearly colliding. The closest match is around 44:10 to 44:22, when a blue and an orange forklift appear in front of the aisle racks, move toward the center, and leave the view, with no collision described.
A fire breaks out on the middle shelving in Aisle 2 starting around 50:17.5, with flames and smoke visible through about 50:40 and the fire gone by 50:47.5.
The lights fade out starting at about 55:40, getting progressively darker until about 55:47.5, and stay dim through 55:57.5. The scene brightens again from 56:05.
